source.text:
name: JMA Early Rain Live Smoke

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "scripts/check-jma-early-rain.ts"
      - ".github/workflows/jma-early-rain-smoke.yml"
      - "lib/weather/providers/jma/**"

jobs:
  live-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm install
      - name: Fetch live JMA early-rain forecast
        run: npx tsx scripts/check-jma-early-rain.ts
